key_points: Book is structured in four parts: Principles, Methods, Forms, and Attitudes
Principles section covers foundational writing concepts
Methods section focuses on structural and technical approaches
Forms section addresses specific types of nonfiction writing
Attitudes section explores writer's mindset and voice
summary: Table of contents for On Writing Well organized into four main parts: Principles, Methods, Forms, and Attitudes, with 24 numbered chapters covering writing fundamentals, techniques, and specific writing forms.
